coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable categories (33%): the p-logP/QED/binding-affinity targets, baseline versus pretrained/chemical-feedback-finetuned model configurations, and structural diversity including long-carbon-chain features. Model-configuration alignment is approximate.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the specified pipeline scripts, fixed DeepSpeed framework, ESR1/ACAA1 targets, and synthetic versus natural-product dataset comparison. Replaces top-three property scores with aggregate statistics and affinity proxies, and omits the target-specific binding-affinity improvements. The proposed generic CPU-based filtering experiment differs substantially from the MOLGEN experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all expected findings: exceptionally high p-logP scores up to 80.30, maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% ESR1 and 70.4% ACAA1 improvements, reduced molecular hallucinations, and maintained molecular diversity.
